terms.comment: Our choice: no reference work has a word for a backup. Classically an exemplar is a copy of a letter or a book (Plin. Ep. 4.7.2: liber in exemplāria trānscrīptus mīlle), and Traupman gives it for a copy on a computer. To back up is exemplar servāre or facere (Traupman 260).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 260.
No source has a word for a backup.
